overview.description: Your organization's security posture at a glance. Jump into any area below.

threatProtection.title: Threat Protection
threatProtection.description: Bot detection, anomalies, rate limits and IP allowlists.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Active sessions across the organization — revoke any you don't recognise.

deviceAuthorizations.title: Device Authorizations
deviceAuthorizations.description: Devices that completed the device-authorization flow.

rateLimits.title: Rate Limits
rateLimits.description: Per-endpoint gateway limits and organization network policy.

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: Hash-chained, append-only record of every security event.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 and data-retention controls.

empty.noAreasDescription: Your organization role does not include security or audit visibility. Ask an organization administrator if you need access.
empty.noOrgDescription: Organization security and audit tools appear once you create or join an organization. Your personal account security lives under Account → Security.

sessions.description: Every active and revoked session for your account. Revoking a session terminates the refresh token immediately.

auditLogs.description: Every state-changing event in this organization, written atomically with the underlying business row.
auditLogs.exportCapped: Capped at {{cap}} rows. Narrow the filter to capture older history.

list.title: Events
list.empty: No events match your filters yet.

auditIntelligence.description: Behavioral-baseline anomaly detection over the audit log: a first-time action type, an unusual hour, or a new IP for an admin's own history. Distinct from Threat Protection's Anomalies, which watches login/session signals.

anomalies.title: Anomalies
anomalies.description: Scored by a background sweep, newest first.

validation.events: Use a whole number of 0 or more.

verify.title: Chain integrity
verify.description: Walk the organization's hash-chained audit log and confirm no row has been tampered with.
verify.brokenLink: It doesn't link to the row before it.
verify.brokenRow: Its content no longer matches its hash.

rateLimits.description: Per-endpoint rate limits and per-organization network policy. Per-organization / per-user / per-api-key overrides are supported by the API; managing them from this screen isn't available yet.

perEndpoint.title: Per-endpoint limits
perEndpoint.description: Built-in token-bucket limits applied at the gateway.

networkPolicy.title: Network access
networkPolicy.description: Which networks may sign in to this organization is set by IP rules.

comingSoon.title: Per-organization rate-limit controls coming to this screen.
comingSoon.description: The API already supports per-organization / per-user / per-api-key overrides; a UI to view and edit them from here is on the way.

bots.description: Detection rules and recent challenges against suspected automated traffic.

rules.title: Detection rules
rules.description: Heuristics evaluated on each authentication attempt. User-Agent fingerprinting is enforced today; the others are stored for upcoming enforcement.
rules.uaCheckHelp: Score known bot UA strings and headless browsers.
rules.honeypotHelp: Hidden form inputs that bots will fill.

logStreaming.description: Stream this organization's audit events to your SIEM or log platform. New events are forwarded from when a sink is added (no history backfill); delivery is at-least-once.

addSink.title: Add a sink
addSink.description: Splunk HEC (token in the HEC field), Datadog (DD-API-KEY), or a generic HTTP endpoint (optional Bearer token).

sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.description: Toggle a sink to pause/resume forwarding.
sinks.emptyDescription: Add a sink above to start streaming audit events.
sinks.toggleAction: Pause or resume a log sink

anomalies.description: Behavioral anomalies detected across logins, sessions, and API access.

ipAllowlist.description: Ranges that may or may not sign in to this organization. Deny rules win over allow rules; if any allow rule exists, an address must match one.
ipAllowlist.disabledBanner: Enforcement is off — these rules are stored but not applied. Switch it on once you've confirmed the address you work from is allowed.

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.description: Add a CIDR range or a single IP address.

validation.cidr: Enter an address or range, such as 203.0.113.0/24.

rules.title: Rules
rules.confirmRemoveAllow: Sign-ins from {{cidr}} will no longer be allowed by this rule, so while enforcement is on they may be refused.
rules.confirmRemoveDeny: Sign-ins from {{cidr}} will no longer be refused by this rule.

test.title: Test an address
test.description: Evaluate an IP against the current rules before turning enforcement on.
test.ipHelp: Checked exactly as a sign-in from that address would be. An address that can't be read is refused.

reasons.allowed: An allow rule matches, or no rule refuses it.
reasons.enforcementOff: Rules aren't enforced, so every address is allowed.

coverage.title: What the rules cover
coverage.applied: While enforcement is on, every sign-in to this organization is checked: password, passkey, magic link, social and enterprise sign-in, invitations, sign-up, the device flow and sign-in to your applications, and every session renewal. A refused sign-in gets no session.
coverage.unknown: If an address can't be determined, sign-in is refused.
coverage.console: This console signs you in from its own server, so the rules see that server's address, not yours. A change that would block the address you're working from is refused, so you can't lock yourself out.
coverage.off: Enforcement is off: the rules are stored but not applied to any sign-in.

refusals.title: Recent refusals
refusals.description: Sign-ins and renewals the rules refused, newest first.

rateLimits.description: Configure per-organization rate limits. Rate is tokens per second; burst is the maximum burst capacity. These override the platform defaults for this organization.

card.title: Rate Limits
card.description: Limits are enforced per bucket (organization, user, API key). Burst allows short spikes above the sustained rate.
card.resetConfirmTitle: Reset all rate limits to platform defaults?
card.resetAction: Reset rate limits to platform defaults

tenant.label: Per-organization
tenant.description: Total requests per second across all users in this organization.

user.label: Per-user
user.description: Requests per second per individual user account.

apiKey.label: Per-API-key
apiKey.description: Requests per second per API key credential.

validation.positive: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.

riskSettings.description: Configure adaptive MFA. When a login's risk score — bot-likeness, plus impossible-travel and device-reputation if you enable them — exceeds your chosen threshold, MFA is required even on a remembered device.

thresholds.title: Risk Thresholds
thresholds.description: Bot scores range from 0 (clearly human) to 1 (clearly automated). A score above the High threshold forces MFA even on a trusted device.
thresholds.mediumHelp: Score at/above this triggers a step-up MFA challenge for unrecognised devices.
thresholds.highHelp: Score at/above this forces MFA even on a trusted/remembered device.
thresholds.forceAtHelp: Which risk level overrides the trusted-device skip.
thresholds.forceAtMedium: Medium — force on any suspicious request
thresholds.forceAtHigh: High — force only on clearly automated requests

impossibleTravel.title: Impossible travel
impossibleTravel.description: Flag a login from a new country too soon after the last one to be plausible travel. Off by default — also needs a trusted upstream proxy to supply a country header (see docs); with none configured this never fires.

deviceReputation.title: Device reputation
deviceReputation.description: Flag a login from a browser + OS combination never seen before for that user. Off by default.

validation.highAboveMedium: The high threshold must be above the medium one.

activity.description: The 20 most recent events across this organization. Auto-refreshes every 15 seconds. For full filtering and search, head to Audit Logs.

securityOverviewPage.investigateIdentityRiskEnforce: Investigate identity risk, enforce policy, and verify control evidence.

toast.rateLimitsResetTo: Rate limits reset to platform defaults

auditLogs.title: View audit logs
auditLogs.subtitle: Browse and filter security audit events

prompts.summarizeAnomalies: Summarize any unusual or high-risk events in the recent audit log.
prompts.failedLogins: Search the audit log for failed authentication events in the last 24 hours.
prompts.adminActions: List the most recent administrative actions by all operators in this tenant.
